name: 🌯 Chicken & Black Bean Power Wraps
what: Chicken, black beans and cheese rolled tight in a tortilla, made to pack.
early: Optional: mix the filling up to 3 days ahead.

core.name: Black beans
core.out: any beans, or skip and add more chicken

core.name: Big tortillas
core.out: any wrap, or make it a bowl over rice

extras: salsa, sour cream, lettuce, lime, taco seasoning

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter.
Chop the chicken. Mix with the drained beans, a little taco seasoning and lime.
Warm tortillas 15 seconds in the microwave.
Sauce (salsa + sour cream), then cheese, then filling, then lettuce. Roll tight.
Cut in half. For lunchboxes, wrap in foil with an ice pack.

key: Cheese goes right on the sauce. It keeps the wrap from going soggy.
done: Rolled tight, and nothing falls out when you cut it.
plan_b: Tortillas tearing? Make it a bowl over rice or lettuce.
